projects.title: BatMonitor
projects.subtitle: Your BMS over Bluetooth
projects.description: A native iOS and Android app that reads XiaoXiang-compatible BMS batteries over Bluetooth LE, with no account and no cloud. It shows live voltage, current, per-cell voltages, protections, balancing and charging state in a dark or light theme.
projects.longDescription: BatMonitor talks directly to the BMS over Bluetooth Low Energy and renders whatever it answers: pack voltage and current, state of charge, remaining and nominal capacity, cycle count, 24 cell voltages with bars, pack imbalance, protections, NTC temperatures and balancing cells. Saved batteries and their last real readings stay on the device, and the app reconnects on its own when the link drops. iOS is built with SwiftUI and Android is a strict Material 3 port in Kotlin with Jetpack Compose; both ship in Spanish and English. Distributed as a signed APK through GitHub Releases, with an in-app update check against a version.json served by GitHub Pages.
highlights: Direct BLE connection to XiaoXiang-compatible BMS units, with automatic reconnect on link drops
Live pack voltage, current, state of charge, capacity, cycle count and 24 per-cell voltages with imbalance
Protections, NTC temperatures and balancing cells surfaced in dedicated summary, cells and status tabs
Native SwiftUI on iOS and a strict Material 3 port in Kotlin + Jetpack Compose on Android, both bilingual

projects.title: Marky
projects.subtitle: Browser-based Markdown editor with live preview
projects.description: A fast Markdown editor that runs entirely in the browser, with a resizable split preview, formatting toolbar and export to HTML. No server, no accounts and no telemetry: everything stays on your device.
projects.longDescription: Marky is a client-side Markdown editor with a real-time preview, resizable and collapsible side panel, line numbers that follow wrapped text, search and replace with regex, a command palette, document outline and recent files. It supports full keyboard shortcuts, drag-and-drop of .md files, undo/redo with its own history and light, dark and sepia themes that respect the system preference. Export is real and self-contained to HTML, plain text or Markdown, with print styles included.
highlights: Real-time editor and preview with a resizable, collapsible side panel and optional scroll sync
Full formatting toolbar, search and replace with regex, command palette and navigable document outline
Light, dark and sepia themes that follow the system preference and apply before first paint
Self-contained export to HTML, plain text or Markdown, including styles and print rules

projects.title: DownGram CLI
projects.subtitle: Interactive Telegram media downloader for the terminal
projects.description: A Python CLI that searches and downloads videos from Telegram channels and groups through interactive menus. It organizes downloads by channel and shows real progress with speed and size.
projects.longDescription: DownGram CLI lets you pick multiple channels or groups to build a search pool, browse paginated results and manually select which videos to download. It handles FloodWaitError and other common Telegram errors, keeps a persistent session so no SMS code is needed on every run and lets you choose a custom destination folder through a native picker or a manual path.
highlights: Smart keyword search across multiple selected channels and groups
Manual selection of results with pagination and multi-select support
Automatic organization of downloads into per-channel folders
Persistent Telegram session with FloodWaitError handling and real progress bars

projects.title: MacMode
projects.subtitle: Native macOS menu bar utility for system profiles
projects.description: A lightweight macOS menu bar agent that switches the Mac between DEV and GAMING profiles in one click. The MVP controls function key behavior through IOKit HID.
projects.longDescription: MacMode puts a profile switch one click away in the menu bar instead of digging through System Settings. It models modes and features as a tested domain layer, applies them through isolated controllers and persists the chosen mode across restarts, with explicit errors and OSLog logging. Built with Swift and SwiftUI, using AppKit and IOKit where macOS integration requires it.
highlights: Menu bar agent with DEV and GAMING profiles, per-mode accent colors and a settings window
Function key behavior controlled through IOKit HID with read-back verification
Idempotent mode transitions with confirmed-versus-desired state and explicit errors
Unit-tested domain layer with mocks, plus a custom mode library with persistence

projects.title: Makp
projects.subtitle: Native macOS MKV player
projects.description: A native macOS MKV player built with SwiftUI and Liquid Glass, with a Finder-style browser, hover preview and a dual AVFoundation/VLC engine. Distributed as a DMG with a public landing page.
projects.longDescription: MAKP is a native macOS video player focused on MKV playback, combining a Finder-like browser with hover previews, playlists with resume and a dual engine that falls back between AVFoundation and VLCKit. It targets macOS 26 and uses Liquid Glass styling, and ships as a signed DMG alongside a public landing page.
highlights: Finder-style file browser with hover preview for quick selection
Dual playback engine combining AVFoundation and VLCKit for broad format support
Playlists with resume and native macOS 26 Liquid Glass interface
Distributed as a DMG with a public landing page and download

projects.title: Downgram Desktop
projects.subtitle: Telegram media downloader for desktop
projects.description: A desktop application for downloading multimedia from Telegram channels, groups and bots. Built with Kotlin Multiplatform and Compose, with a native feel on every platform.
projects.longDescription: Downgram Desktop brings the DownGram downloading workflow to the desktop as a Kotlin Multiplatform app with a Compose UI, Ktor networking and coroutines. It targets JVM desktop builds and reuses the same download and organization logic across platforms.
highlights: Kotlin Multiplatform desktop app with a Compose Multiplatform interface
Downloads media from Telegram channels, groups and bots
Ktor-based networking and coroutine-driven concurrency
Native desktop packaging for macOS and Windows

projects.title: Patrona
projects.subtitle: Accounting management system for startups
projects.description: An accounting management system built for the La Patrona startup, with invoicing, balances and financial dashboards. Full-stack on Next.js with MongoDB.
projects.longDescription: Patrona is a modern accounting platform for startups, covering income, expenses, invoicing and balances with an interactive financial dashboard and report generation. It is built as a full-stack Next.js app with Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui components, MongoDB Atlas and Mongoose, written in TypeScript.
highlights: Integral accounting: income, expenses, invoicing and balances
Interactive dashboard with real-time financial metrics
Report generation including balance sheet, income statement and cash flow
Customizable templates adaptable to different business models

projects.title: YouTube Downloader
projects.subtitle: Download YouTube videos in your browser or terminal
projects.description: Paste a YouTube link and download it in your browser, with a Python CLI powered by yt-dlp for maximum quality. No accounts or ads, fully local.
projects.longDescription: YouTube Downloader ships a local web app and a Python CLI sharing the same quality logic: the browser path downloads MP4 up to 1080p, while running the local server unlocks maximum quality, MP3 audio and full playlists. The CLI ships as a single binary and handles 4K merge, playlists and MP3 320kbps via ffmpeg.
highlights: Browser-based download with real progress, speed and size indicators
Local server mode unlocking maximum quality, MP3 audio and full playlists
Python CLI shipped as a single binary with 4K merge via ffmpeg
Shared quality logic between the web app and the CLI
